messages:
Alex C: quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — capturing remediation owners & timelines so nothing drifts. I listed items below, pls ack or update if wrong.

- Token validation: add runtime checks + integration tests -> owner: Samir P, ETA: 2w
- Permission prune: schedule review across services -> owner: Maria G, ETA: 3w
- Audit logging: ensure IAM role is in audit pipeline + retention policy -> owner: Jing L, ETA: 1w
- Secrets rotation: automate rotation job + alerting on failures -> owner: Taylor O, ETA: 4w
- Runbook updates + oncall playbook link -> owner: Alex C, ETA: 1w

Anyone want to swap ownership or change ETAs? :eyes:

Maria G: thanks alex, that's a great start. for permission prune can we split by repo owner? I can take the core infra services but would like someone from product infra to do SDKs. also adding a note to track ACLs that stem from legacy feature flags.

Samir P: ack. i'll start with the token runtime checks this week. plan: add assertions in validation layer, then add a fuzz test in the harness. PRs will reference this thread.

Jing L: ack. for audit logging I'll add a quick query to verify events are flowing and create an alert if missing. query I'll use: 
```sql
SELECT event_time, principal, resource, action FROM audit_logs WHERE action LIKE '%auth%' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Will attach dashboards to the incident board.

Taylor O: ack. for secrets rotation — I propose we ship the operator for automated rotations (k8s CronJob) and a fallback Lambda for legacy apps. also adding escalation to PagerDuty if rotation fails twice. ETA 4w sounds fine.

Alex C: thanks everyone. two followups: (1) can we get owners to add a single-line status update in the incident board by EOD Fri? (2) jing + sec-bot — can we add an hourly audit lag check so we know within 1 hour if logs stop?

sec-bot: automated reminder created -> https://redwood.example/incidents/2095001234/actions (adds reminders every 24h until closed)

Jing L: noted — will add hourly lag alert. putting it on my card and will create the PagerDuty escalation action.

Samir P: FYI, token tests will include: invalid signature, expired tokens, missing audience, and token header tampering. I'll also add a short performance microbenchmark to ensure checks don't add >1ms p50.

Maria G: i'll coordinate SDK owners and create a shared spreadsheet for ACL review assignments. tagging product infra leads in the doc.

Taylor O: documenting rotation operator in the runbook. question for Alex: should rotation alert go to security-only channel or infra-oncall too?

Alex C: put it to infra-oncall with a CC to security for first 3 months, then we can evaluate based on noise.

Samir P: posted initial PR draft to repo: https://git.redwood/inference/token-validation/pull/12 — comments welcome.

Alex C: excellent. i'll follow up next Tue with a short checkpoint. if folks hit blockers earlier drop them here or in the incidents channel. :thumbsup:
